ne: Sarmal keyword çok-dilli sözlük — view-layer i18n (karar A · yayın dil kapısı). Kanonik = TR (disk hep Türkçe, tek gerçek → drift yok); ekran/çıktı hedef dile çevrilir. Kapsam: kanonik evrenin TAMAMI — `widget` düğüm tipleri, `kenar` kenar tipleri, `parametre` alan adları, `deger` enum değerleri (alan kapsamlı: görünürlük.açık=public ≠ durum.açık=open). Kaynak evren `oz/siniflama/kayit.json`'dur ve kapsama `cekirdek/sinama/sozluk-kapsama.test.ts` nöbetiyle sürekli ölçülür — kanona karşılıksız bir tip/alan/kenar/enum eklenirse süit kırmızıya döner. `takmaAdlar` kanonda karşılığı olmayan eski anahtarlardır (geriye dönük). `belirsiz` emin olunmayan karşılıkların gerekçe defteridir; uydurulmuş bir karşılık emin gibi durmasın diye açıkça işaretlenir. Diller: tr (kanonik) · en (dolu) · az · ar (yapısı hazır — Founder doldurur). DÜZYAZI KATMANI (CDL-A01 ikinci yarısı): ad çevirmek tek başına yetmez, çünkü kullanıcı İngilizce bir adın yanında Türkçe bir açıklama görürse bu hiç çevirmemekten daha kötüdür. Bu yüzden kanonun kullanıcıya GÖRÜNEN düzyazısı da burada paralel yüzey olarak yaşar ve `widgetNe` (`kayit.json` widgetTipleri[].ne — 101 tip), `kenarNe` (kenarTipleri[].ne — 19 kenar) ve `semaKural` (semalar[].kural — 35 şema) bölümlerinde tutulur. Anahtar deseni ad bölümleriyle AYNIDIR: kanonik Türkçe anahtar → { dil: metin }; bölüm adı ise `<mevcut bölüm> + aynaladığı kanon alanı` biçimindedir, böylece ikinci bir desen doğmaz. Türkçe metin kaynakta kalır, silinmez — bu katman onun İngilizce EŞİDİR. Düzyazının içinde alan ve kenar adları İNGİLİZCE yazılır (`dependsOn:`, `basedOn:`), çünkü görünüm katmanı i18n'inde İngilizce okuyan kullanıcı ekranda zaten o adı görür; buna karşılık ayrıştırıcı anahtar kelimeleri (`çağır`), tanı kodları (`beceri-drift`), dosya yolları ve kanon kodları (MIM-2 · YAS-1.1) kimlik oldukları için çevrilmez.

bilgi.en: knowledge & experience (decision · formula · glossary · idea · experiment)

yuzey.en: contains (UI tree — what the user sees)

teknoloji.en: depends on (adapter: technology · MCP · tool · model · environment)

surec.en: execution trace (task · run · trace · git) — record created at run time

arkayuz.en: server surface (service · endpoint · table · queue) — the UI's counterpart

mevsim.en: Phase — year-ring 🌀 (TIME axis: a growth period; sibling phases are ordered)

gövde.en: Block — WORK (the SAME trunk grows across seasons; cross-phase `çağır` continuity)

özsu.en: the knowledge family (Decision·Formula·Glossary·Idea·Insight·Experiment·Philosophy·Mockup) — the distillation layer that turns outside light into nourishment; an insight flows to the branch it feeds via the --> edge, and a leaf that does not flow does not feed the tree (Founder's metaphor · 2026-08-10)

1.en: weak — the record is markedly problematic

2.en: developing — the record contains repeated setbacks

5.en: exemplary — the record is held up as an example to the roster

kabulIsabeti.en: whether acceptance items were met with evidence in closed Steps (run seals; a reopened Step lowers accuracy)

denetimTemizligi.en: the check verdict at closure (0 errors expected; produced drift is recorded)

sinamaYesilligi.en: suite status at the closing commit (gate records)

founderSinyalleri.en: appreciation/honor/suggestion records written on the Step (human signal, read qualitatively rather than numerically)

ÇalışmaAlanı.en: the garden / workspace — a single foundation; it wraps many Apps in parallel (M-01)

Uygulama.en: one app (a tree); developed in parallel inside a Workspace

Proje.en: the productive root (MAIN); one tree / a Structure-First declaration

Blok.en: the trunk — this is the WORK axis; it fuses frontend and backend steps under a single identity and carries on across phases through the `çağır` (call) edge

Faz.en: a season or a year-ring — this is the TIME axis; it wraps Blocks, and sibling phases are ordered — the engine derives that order

Katman.en: a branch — this is the TECHNOLOGY axis (frontend · backend · security and the like); many Layers may live under one Block and each one expects a TechStack binding

AltKatman.en: a small branch — the DISCIPLINE axis (MIM-1.5): it stands for one of the five core disciplines — planning · coding · testing · review · security — through the `discipline:` field; it INHERITS its technology binding from the root Layer and declares none of its own; a Sublayer nested inside a Sublayer trips the deep-nesting brake

Adım.en: the leaf — the smallest unit of work; it carries the context-cone fields (task · references · accept · doNotTouch · dependsOn · boundary); dependency is MECHANICAL and is written only with the `dependsOn: [CODE]` edge

Kapı.en: an acceptance checkpoint — a gate that verifies a stage and lets it through (GATE)

Karar.en: a decision record; it enters a Step's context cone through the `feeds` and `references` edges

Formül.en: a scientific formula or first principle — an informs edge into the Step

Fikir.en: a raw, uncommitted idea; once it matures it is promoted to a Decision

Çıkarım.en: an insight distilled from an external source: the source is mandatory and an outgoing `-->` edge is STRONGLY ADVISED — 'where it was applied' is a live arrow, not a dead column

Deney.en: hypothesis + result (experiment/spike); it feeds a Decision

Felsefe.en: a manifesto document defending one of Sarmal's principles or its vision (FEL-*); it carries a thesis plus a rationale and feeds Decisions and Laws

Mockup.en: an external design truth (Figma · HTML · image) — taken as a reference exactly as it is; it is NEVER summarized, and its location is declared with the `file:` parameter

Orkestrasyon.en: manages the agent pool; it derives prompts from a Step and dispatches them at run time

Döngü.en: recurring work: it turns on a trigger, drives its `runs` chain, and STOPS on `stopWhen` or `maxRounds`; a loop with no way out cannot be written

Şablon.en: the context/prompt format handed to an agent (new — the CAT-0 TPL pattern)

Kanca.en: a lifecycle hook (before/after/error); the enforcement engine

Mekanizma.en: a cross-cutting infrastructure module (governance · RBAC · telemetry · rate limiting · auditing); declared ONCE and then referenced or depended on by many Steps; its content is never scattered across steps, it stays in one place

Etmen.en: identity + skills + isolated memory + constitution + hooks + triggers

Yetenek.en: a stack-agnostic capability declaration (F-2): Skills bind to it with `provides:` — the Flutter and React implementations of the same capability are separate Skills

Beceri.en: a capability bound to an agent; distilled out of Memory

Bellek.en: the agent's isolated memory (ogrenme/); failures and lessons are recorded here

Tetikleyici.en: the "when to use it" condition; on a match the Skill fires automatically (TRG)

Ekran.en: the UI root (Scaffold); declarative intent written in Sarmal rather than framework code

Yığın.en: place elements on top of one another (Stack)

Kapsayıcı.en: a box for size, color and spacing (Container)

ÖzelKural.en: a function-like rule node defined by the user

Kural.en: the rule node: it carries the authority · eternal · layer · scope fields together with the condition, violation and severity triad; Constitution and Policy wrap this node

Anayasa.en: one shared rule set for ALL agents (not claude.md/gemini.md)

Mevzuat.en: an external legal or regulatory norm (F-7): not a rule but the SOURCE of a rule — it carries source/jurisdiction/enforcement plus a `requires:` edge; the implementation lives in a Policy or a Step

Teknoloji.en: the concrete external system the work rests on — a software stack (Flutter · Next · FastAPI) or the channel the work is carried out through (Google Business Profile · Meta accounts)

Takım.en: a technology stack — a coherent set adopted together (`dependsOn:` lists the members); a project or agent stack is invoked as a whole

MCP.en: an MCP server — the governed tool-access gateway for agents

Meyve.en: the fruit 🍎 — a traceable deliverable born from a Step's `produces` edge (MIM-2): the producing Step, the kind, and (for file-mandatory kinds) an in-project file are all visible together; a Fruit whose producer is unclear is not accepted

Kod.en: generated source code (a fruit 🍎; adapted per language)

Sözleşme.en: an API contract plus a database schema (OpenAPI/GraphQL)

Görev.en: a unit of work assigned to an agent, with status (assigned/running/done); the orchestration primitive

Koşum.en: an execution record — the live stream, the radio trace of a run

Komut.en: the prompt issued to an agent

Git.en: a commit / PR / release / branch record

Sorun.en: a tracked bug, issue or feature

Sınama.en: a test unit — it verifies a Step or a Block against its acceptance

DurumKaydı.en: a session snapshot for rehydration (DRM — where we left off)

ÜstÇubuk.en: the top title and action bar (AppBar); the crown of a Screen

Gövde.en: the main content area of a screen (Body); it carries scrolling and safe-area

Form.en: a validation container wrapping input fields; it declares when validation runs

MetinAlanı.en: text input from the user (TextField); it carries a kind and a validator

OnayKutusu.en: a multi-select checkbox; it binds to a state field

AçılırListe.en: a dropdown option list; it carries its values and the selected one

AnlıkBildirim.en: a short-lived bottom notification (SnackBar/Toast); it carries a source and a duration

Canlandırma.en: animation intent: kind + duration + curve + repeat; either a preset or an inline value

Durum.en: application or screen State intent: fields + source; it binds into the UI

Servis.en: a business-logic container; base path + version + logging + observability; it wraps Endpoints

Uç.en: an API endpoint: path + method + request/response contract + authorization + rate limit

Tablo.en: the INTENT of a database table: schema (from a Contract) + indexes; it produces a Migration

KimlikPolitikası.en: an authentication policy: token lifetime + password algorithm + lockout — the identity-domain boundary is the IdentityRoot type's job and external providers are the IdentityProvider type's job; the three roles are distinct and cannot be merged

KimlikKökü.en: the identity-domain boundary (MIM-1.1 · ORK-5): it covers the user pool, the IdentityPolicy in force and the set of providers; under shared Auth, Projects share one root through the `uses` edge and Project identities never merge

KimlikSağlayıcısı.en: an external identity provider (ORK-5.1): it lives under exactly one IdentityRoot; the base catalogue is google · github · linkedin · apple · microsoft · sso, and it may be extended only through an additive overlay

Kuyruk.en: an asynchronous job queue; retry + backoff policy

ArkaGörev.en: a background job: trigger + queue + timeout

Olay.en: event / webhook intent: name + payload (a Contract) + publication direction

Önbellek.en: cache intent: provider + lifetime + key; it is also usable as an Endpoint value

Gizli.en: the DECLARATION of a secret: provider + name — the value itself is never written down

Raf.en: a folder declaration — a shelf of the structure; its location comes from the `path:` parameter and content is wrapped inside the shelf, because a shelf and what it holds are different things

Kitaplık.en: a branching folder — a library holds SHELVES (and, as sections, sub-libraries); the metaphor is Library › Shelf › Book › Page

bağımlı.en: A depends on B; it lays the foundation of the call chain

referans.en: A cites B (provenance); the Step context cone

hatırlat.en: a Reminder binds into the context of Step B (forward binding)

üretir.en: when A is built it produces B (a fruit 🍎)

yönetir.en: orchestrator or agent A manages B

besler.en: A feeds data or context into B

dayanak.en: rule or policy A is born out of decision B; it records the trail between a decision and a rule so that 'who decided this?' can be read straight off the graph

mevsim.en: the time edge: a Block binds itself to the phase in force from its own file; the load cycle normalizes that binding into a virtual `çağır` (call) edge on the Phase side, so the panel, the report card and the phase-less-block audit cover both spellings unchanged — the conversion happens at a SINGLE point

anayasa.en: agent A is governed by constitution B

tetikler.en: when Trigger A's structural condition is met it fires Skill B

tema.en: the design-system binding: which Theme contract a screen is dressed in (the theme-less-screen guard looks for this)

çağırır.en: the behavior edge: Button or Form A calls endpoint B

gider.en: the navigation edge: A navigates to screen B

gönderir.en: the data edge: Form A submits to endpoint B

sözleşme.en: the convergence edge: Endpoint A derives from contract B — the contract is written first

koşar.en: the run edge: Loop A drives the steps and orchestrations in B

kullanır.en: the technology and identity binding: a Layer uses exactly one concrete Technology (MIM-1.4), and a Project uses either the shared IdentityRoot or its own (ORK-5); the target of the binding never merges identities

Etmen.en: Hook limits (at most 10 hooks, at most 500 ms) are to be written into the constitution as a threshold rule.

Beceri.en: The CONSUMING side declares the binding: the Step writes `uses: BCR-…`, and no task list is kept on the Skill; the same fact cannot live in two places. The body must be at most 300 lines. The `describes:` field declares the rule or the diagnostic the skill teaches; each list entry is either a resolvable node CODE or the name of a diagnostic held in the diagnostic registry (for example `kenar-metin`). A declaration that fails to resolve raises the `beceri-drift` diagnostic, because teaching material cannot come loose from the rule it teaches.

Bellek.en: The pointer principle: a `see:` address, never the content itself; the owner is the enclosing Agent (isolation); pending promotions are measured by the Auditor (F-3, locked 2026-07-02). The optional `evidence:` field shows where a lesson was learned; a lesson with evidence can be argued for when it comes up for promotion, whereas a lesson without evidence is only a claim.

Politika.en: A Policy binds to the Decision record it rests on through the `basedOn:` edge.

Mekanizma.en: The `phase:` field is a FREE label with no fixed value list; the language stays generic, because product-side phase names are never written into the substrate. The ordering between Mechanisms is read from the acyclic graph built by the `dependsOn:` edges. Cross-cutting content (Policy · Rule · Metric · Log · Security) stays INSIDE the mechanism and is never scattered across steps.

Mevzuat.en: A `requires: [Step|Gate|Policy]` edge — an unbound Regulation is an orphan (F-7, locked 2026-07-02)

Hatırlatıcı.en: When a reminder is anchored to a step, the `reminds:` CODE is mandatory; the reminder travels with the target Step's cone once that Step becomes active, and closing the target while the reminder is still open counts as a missed reminder. When the anchor is anything other than a step (architecture · law · quality · future), `returnTrigger:` is mandatory, because the event that will wake the reminder has to be written down. The anchors rank as follows: architecture comes distinctly before step; step comes before law and quality, and those come before future. This ranking is separate from the priority field. A completed record stays where it is; an obsolete one is deleted. The lifecycle moves through open, decided and then done or obsolete; decided is the moment the work enters the chain, and at that moment the `reminds:` Step CODE becomes mandatory. There are three legitimate ways to satisfy it: attach the reminder to an existing Step, open a new Step in between, or — if the target is already finished — update the code at the same time.

Değerlendirme.en: The scorer is the auditor agent (isolated memory); the decision engine reads the GRAPH (F-10, locked 2026-07-02). The optional `date:` field says which day the evaluation was made; because a score goes stale over time, the day of the measurement carries as much information as the measurement itself.

Sözleşme.en: At least one face is mandatory (endpoint: request/response · data: fields); a field is described by a COMPACT map — 'kind · rule · rule' (F-6, locked 2026-07-02)

Karar.en: A Decision carries the decision itself, its rationale and its status; A DECISION WITHOUT A RATIONALE IS INVALID. THE VALIDITY MODEL is as follows: decision texts are history and are untouchable; a superseded decision is stamped `status: revised` together with a `successor:`, and a revision whose successor has not been written raises a warning; one-off finished matters take `status: archived`. The document face is rendered in two sections, in force and history. THE SUMMARY LAYER: the optional `summary:` field is a single paragraph readable by someone who does not know the context; the ledger face and the tooltip show the summary first, while the raw decision text is preserved byte for byte in the history. ADOPTION STATUS: the optional `adoption:` field is declared honestly as one of required, selfContained or deferred; a decision that is required, locked and tied to no plan raises the unimplemented-decision warning, because the binding is searched for in reverse along the `basedOn`, `applies` and `references` edges. The reason for deferring lives in the `deferralReason` field.

Formül.en: thesis + source — a `feeds` / `-->` edge is MANDATORY (an unbound formula is an orphan; the lesson learned when the very first formula record was left orphaned)

Fikir.en: what + `status: park` + returnTrigger — NO commitment (the un-promised sibling of the Reminder)

Çıkarım.en: what + source — an outgoing `-->` edge is STRONGLY ADVISED. The mandatory claim was withdrawn on 2026-08-10 because its cited basis F-12 was defined nowhere, the engine never enforced the edge and sixty-two of ninety-eight live Insights carried no edge; declaring a rule broken in forty places keeps a green gate lying. The recommendation rests on the tree metaphor: a distilled insight should flow to the branch it feeds. Because an Insight is distilled from an external source it carries two optional fields: `date:` says which day it was distilled and `evidence:` names the concrete backing that supports it. Neither is mandatory, because not every insight can be dated or reduced to a single piece of evidence.

Felsefe.en: what + thesis — A PHILOSOPHY WITHOUT A THESIS IS JUST TALK; it defends a position together with its rationale and lays it out in the document block

Kural.en: The `scope:` field is a FREE selector and cannot be enumerated by a fixed value list: it accepts the wildcard `genel` (synonym `tümü`), a family name, a type name or a single CODE. A selector that fails to resolve raises the unknown-scope warning; on a structurally conditioned rule, a selector that matches no node at all raises the empty-scope warning.

Tema.en: The token-ROLE contract: a .sar file carries only the NAME/ROLE — the VALUE (hex/px) is NEVER written into .sar; it lives in the technology file (ThemeData/:root) and its location is read from the `file:` output-location declaration. The map+hex spelling (the old form) still goes through the invalid-color and low-contrast guards; the role-list spelling is the recommended one.

Blok.en: The `season:` field is the binding a Block makes from its own file to the Phase in force, and it carries exactly one CODE; the load cycle normalizes that binding into a virtual `çağır` (call) edge. A binding is written in one place only: writing the same binding both here and in the Phase's `çağır` list raises the duplicate-season-record warning. The `unplanned:` field is the honest declaration of work for which no date has been committed; its value is the WHY text and it cannot be left empty, because an empty declaration is no declaration at all and the phase-less-block finding stands.

Proje.en: The regime contract (the YAS-1 family): under the strict regime every Layer→Step containment path passes through at least one Sublayer and a Layer may not hold a Step directly (YAS-1.1 · the enforcing `katı-rejim-altkatman-eksik` diagnostic is still owed by the engine); only in small or experimental Projects declared flexible may a Layer hold a Step directly, and that permission does not forbid Sublayers (YAS-1.2); the regime changes only through an explicit user action — structure is never auto-wrapped, moved or deleted, and nodes that contradict the target regime carry a visible diagnostic until they are fixed (YAS-1.3)

Faz.en: A Phase is the TIME axis; the `dueDate` field carries the phase's calendar in ISO format. A Phase that holds Blocks requires a date and is flagged if it has none; overdue and approaching deadlines are measured by an engine guard.

Katman.en: Technology singularity (MIM-1.4): every Layer binds to exactly one concrete Technology through the `uses` edge; a Layer with no technology, or one bound to several, cannot be built — such a requirement is split into separate Layers. A Sublayer inherits this binding unchanged and declares none of its own

Adım.en: The feedback channels (🙏 thanks · ❤️ appreciation · 🏅 honor · 💡 suggestion) are written onto a completed Step by the Founder alone. The cone fields (task · accept · boundary · doNotTouch · references) are OPTIONAL in the schema; when they become mandatory is decided by the cone-less-step guard, so that one rule never gets two separate gates. THE APPROVAL FIELD is the Founder's own ruling and is written from the mailbox panel; the gate decision lives above the Step and below the owner of the record. A ruling the controller makes alone, in the Founder's absence, is NOT a field of the Step: that ruling is written as its own `Decision` node and bound to the Step with a `references:` edge, because a decision has its own identity, its own rationale and its own validity status. Using one name for two different meanings across two different types misleads the reader.

DurumKaydı.en: A session handover is transferred without loss through standard sections. The sections are these: the progress field is a single sentence carrying one CODE; the next field gives the priority chain; the locks field lists the rulings that do not change between sessions; the openItems field holds the pending items, gate status included; and the summary field is the body that carries the session narrative.

GenelKural.en: A GeneralRule is a Rule whose scope defaults to `genel` (everything), and it governs the ENTIRE workspace. There is no separate evaluator: the rule engine evaluates it in the same place as every other rule.

ÖzelKural.en: A CustomRule is a Rule that descends into the directory named in its `target:` field; what separates this type from the other one is its scope. Outside the target, structural and threshold evaluation is skipped. There is no separate evaluator: the rule engine is the same.

Teknoloji.en: The `footprint:` field holds, as a list, the known configuration, scaffold and generated-file traces a technology leaves on disk. The auditor treats these paths as DECLARED off-backbone and resolves them RELATIVE to the directory the declaration lives in. This is an allowlist with its reason written down, not a blanket silencer. Command-line tools that leave traces on disk (pnpm · wrangler) are modelled as Tools, not as Technologies.

Takım.en: code + what + dependsOn (the members) — A TECHSTACK WITH NO MEMBERS IS INVALID; every member is a resolvable Technology or TechStack CODE (drift-checked)

KimlikKökü.en: The identity-domain boundary (MIM-1.1 · ORK-5): it covers exactly one IdentityPolicy and wraps zero or more IdentityProviders; Projects on shared Auth point to this root with the `uses` edge and Project identities never merge. A provider with no root, and a policy outside a root, are violations; engine enforcement is still owed by the engine round under the `auth-omurgası-ihlali` diagnostic

KimlikSağlayıcısı.en: The base provider catalogue is closed (ORK-5.1): google · github · linkedin · apple · microsoft · sso are preserved in full; a new provider may be added only through an additive enum extension in the Workspace overlay, and a base option may never be deleted or renamed. A provider lives under exactly one IdentityRoot

Meyve.en: A Fruit is born from exactly one Step's `produces` edge (MIM-2); the Code, Screen, Endpoint and Contract kinds declare an in-project `file` (MIM-2.1), while the Decision, Approval and externalOutput kinds sit in the canonical exemption catalogue (MIM-2.2) — no free-form exemption outside that catalogue may be invented. Enforcement of the producer-less Fruit is still owed by the engine round under the `üretimsiz-meyve` diagnostic

Kod.en: A Kod node is the product family's concrete source-code fruit; when it declares a `dosya`, the path passes through the very same MIM-2.1 disk validation as a Meyve. A Kod node without that declaration is exempt from the validation, because making the field mandatory would require a new canon clause widening the scope of MIM-2.1, and a canon clause is a Founder gate

Uç.en: A data schema NEVER lives on an Endpoint; it lives in a Contract. The identity and secret flags are likewise declared at the Contract level.

Koşum.en: A Step's last `sef` (chef) run is written back into the plan as `runLog: Run(...)`. This record is not a free-form map — it is validated against the schema; its seal and decision values match the `sef` stop summary exactly.

Sınıflama.en: A singleton — SNF-0 has exactly one instance; the version lives in kayit.json (repeating it on the node would be a double record), and its twin is kayit.md

Döngü.en: An exit condition is mandatory IN THE SCHEMA: a Loop cannot be built without at least one of the `stopWhen` and `maxRounds` fields, so a loop that cannot stop itself is rejected at the front door of the language. The run record is kept under `.sarmal/trace`.

Mockup.en: The mockup-by-reference mode: a mockup is NEVER summarized — the .sar file carries only the reference (a Step or Screen writes `references: [ MOK-… ]`); the detail lives in the mockup file ITSELF, because a lossy summary misses the intent, and the mere existence of a summary is no proof that it is correct.

AltKatman.en: The canonical discipline field name is `discipline:` (MIM-1.5); the name `rol:` is reserved for RBAC and agent roles and is not used on a Sublayer — the old spelling is never silently converted, and the transition runs through a visible report. The technology binding is declared on the ROOT Layer and inherited by the Sublayer (the layer-less-technology guard does not look at Sublayers); a Sublayer{Sublayer} raises the deep-nesting info diagnostic (a depth brake — a question, not a penalty)

belirsiz.widget.Felsefe: Philosophy kimliği birebir korur; kanonun `ne` alanı ise tipi 'manifesto belgesi' diye tarif eder — Manifesto da savunulabilir. Kimlik sadakati gerekçesiyle Philosophy seçildi, Founder onayı ister.
belirsiz.widget.Mekanizma: Mechanism birebir karşılıktır; kanonun `ne` alanı tipi 'kesişen altyapı modülü' diye tanımlar ve CrossCuttingModule anlamca daha dar/doğrudur ama tip adı olarak uzundur.
belirsiz.widget.Yasa: Law hukuk metaforunu korur; kanonun `ne` alanı ise yalnız 'kural rafı' der ve RuleShelf anlamca daha doğrudur. Anayasa=Constitution · Kural=Rule ile aynı register'da kalsın diye Law seçildi.
belirsiz.widget.Mevzuat: Regulation seçildi (kanon 'dış hukuki/düzenleyici norm' der, yargıAlanı + yaptırım alanları taşır); zemin belgesi Statute önermişti. Statute yasama organı metnidir, Mevzuat ondan geniştir.
belirsiz.widget.Takım: TechStack bir icattır: birebir karşılık Stack'tir ama Stack kilitli olarak Yığın'a aittir. Çakışmayı çözmek için TechStack yazıldı.
belirsiz.widget.Meyve: KARARA BAĞLANDI — Founder hükmü 2026-07-29: 'meyve artifact olmasın, ağaç metaforu ingilizcede de kalsın.' Karşılık Fruit'tir. Artifact yazılım dünyasının yerleşik terimidir ve önce o seçilmişti, fakat metaforu tümüyle öldürüyordu; Sarmal'ın ağaç metaforu bir süs değil dilin kendi omurgasıdır ve İngilizce yüzeyde de omurga kalır. Bu kayıt belirsiz defterinde TUTULUYOR çünkü seçimin gerekçesi kaybolmamalıdır; artık bir soru değil, verilmiş bir hükümdür.
belirsiz.widget.Sınıflama: Taxonomy tip sistemleri için yerleşiktir; Classification birebir karşılıktır. Yerleşiklik gerekçesiyle Taxonomy seçildi.
belirsiz.widget.Çıkarım: Insight seçildi çünkü kanonun `ne` alanı 'damıtılan içgörü' der; Finding de yaygındır.
belirsiz.parametre.ne: what mevcut sözlükten gelen KİLİTLİ karşılıktır; yazılım geleneğinde summary daha yerleşiktir fakat `özet` alanı zaten summary'dir, bu yüzden çakışırdı.
belirsiz.parametre.kabul: accept KİLİTLİ karşılıktır; Founder'ın brifingdeki 'acceptance criteria' karşılığı alan ADI değil PANEL ETİKETİDİR ve etiket katmanı bu sözlükte yaşamaz.
belirsiz.parametre.sınır: boundary KİLİTLİ karşılıktır; brifingdeki 'scope boundary' yine panel etiketidir.
belirsiz.parametre.yuvarlaklık: rounded KİLİTLİ karşılıktır; radius CSS/Flutter geleneğinde daha yerleşiktir ama kilitliye dokunulmadı.
belirsiz.parametre.evre: lifecycle seçildi çünkü alan Kanca'nın önce/sonra/hata evresidir; birebir 'when' zaten `neZaman` alanına, 'phase' zaten `faz` alanına gitti.
belirsiz.parametre.tür: kind seçildi; type DEĞİL — Sarmal'da `tip` düğüm tipidir, `tür` onun alt-türüdür ve iki kavram ayrı kalmalıdır.
belirsiz.parametre.yetki: clearance seçildi (L1–L6 kademesi bir yetki SEVİYESİDİR); authority zaten `otorite` alanına gitti.
belirsiz.parametre.departman: discipline seçildi; department birebir karşılıktır ama planlama/kodlama/sınama/inceleme/güvenlik beşlisi bir disiplin ayrımıdır, bir örgüt birimi değil.
belirsiz.parametre.dokunulmaz: doNotTouch seçildi; immutable ya da protected da savunulabilir fakat alan bir dosya/bölge yasağını beyan eder, değişmezlik niteliği değil.
belirsiz.parametre.kimlik: identifier seçildi çünkü alan yalnız Model tipinde yaşar ve sağlayıcının model kimliğini taşır; modelId daha dar ama daha nettir.
belirsiz.parametre.rejim: regime birebir karşılıktır; mode daha sadedir. Reformun 'rejim' kavramı terim olarak yerleşik olduğu için birebir karşılık korundu.
belirsiz.parametre.koşu: runLog seçildi (Adım'ın koşum kaydı); run zaten Koşum TİPİNE ait olduğu için çakışmayı önlemek gerekti.
belirsiz.parametre.neredeyiz: progress seçildi; birebir 'whereWeAre' İngilizcede tuhaf kaçar.
belirsiz.parametre.uygulama: adoption seçildi (gerekli/kendinden-tam/ertelendi üçlüsü bir benimseme kararıdır); implementation birebir ama yanıltıcıdır.
belirsiz.parametre.alan: dimension seçildi çünkü Politika'nın `alan` değerleri öğrenme/maliyet/güvenlik/hız/içerik bir EKSEN kümesidir; field ya da area yanıltıcı olurdu.
belirsiz.kenar.mevsim: season metaforu korur (Blok → Faz); inPhase anlamca daha nettir ama metaforu öldürür.
belirsiz.kenar.anayasa: governedBy seçildi (A, B'nin anayasasına tabidir); constitution birebir olurdu ama kenar bir İLİŞKİ adıdır, nesne adı değil.
belirsiz.kenar.dayanak: basedOn seçildi; groundedIn de önerilmişti. `dayanak` hem alan hem kenar olduğu için iki bölümde AYNI karşılık yazıldı.
belirsiz.kenar.sözleşme: contract seçildi; conformsTo ilişkiyi daha açık anlatır ama `sözleşme` alan adıyla aynı kalsın diye tek karşılık tercih edildi.
belirsiz.deger.durum.*beklemede: Baştaki yıldız kanonun VARSAYILAN işaretidir (motor normalize ederken sıyırır), çeviri değildir; bu yüzden `*pending` olarak korundu.
belirsiz.deger.aşama.yasa-taslağı: draftLaw seçildi; billDraft ya da proposedRule da savunulabilir.
belirsiz.deger.hedef.etmen-çıktısı: agentOutput seçildi; dış-çıktı için externalOutput yazıldı — ikisi de birebir çeviridir, yerleşik bir sektör terimi yoktur.
belirsiz.deger.kademe.usta: usta/ağır/işçi/hızlı dörtlüsü model kademesidir; master/heavy/worker/fast birebir çeviridir ve sektörde premium/standard/fast gibi karşılıklar da vardır.
belirsiz.deger.tetik.zaman: schedule seçildi (zamanlanmış tetik); time birebir ama tetik türü olarak anlamsızdır.
belirsiz.deger.çapa.nitelik: quality seçildi; `nitelik` ailesi sınama/metrik/güvenlik/kapsama demektir, attribute değil.
belirsiz.widgetNe.Meyve: KARARA BAĞLANDI — Founder hükmü 2026-07-29. Düzyazı ile tip adı arasındaki kopukluk kapandı: düzyazı 'the fruit 🍎' diyordu ama tip adı Artifact'tı, dolayısıyla İngilizce okuyan kullanıcı ikisi arasındaki bağı ancak cümleyi okuyarak kurabiliyordu. Artık ikisi de Fruit'tir ve bağ kurmaya gerek kalmamıştır.
belirsiz.widgetNe.Blok: `çağır` ayrıştırıcı anahtar kelimesidir ve sözlükte karşılığı yoktur; düzyazıda `çağır` (call) biçiminde parantezli sözlükle bırakıldı. Anahtar kelimenin İngilizce yazımı seçenek B'nin (v2) işidir.
belirsiz.kenarNe.mevsim: Aynı gerekçe: `çağır` anahtar kelimesi Türkçe bırakıldı ve parantez içinde (call) diye sözlüklendi.
belirsiz.semaKural.Kural: `genel` ve `tümü` seçici DEĞERLERİDİR, enum değil; sözlükte karşılıkları yoktur ve motor onları harfi harfine arar. Bu yüzden düzyazıda Türkçe bırakılıp parantezle açıklandılar.
belirsiz.semaKural.Koşum: ŞEF orkestratörü `sef` MCP aracının adıdır ve araç adları CDL-A05'e göre SABİTTİR; düzyazıda `sef` (chef) biçiminde yazıldı. Araç adının çevrilip çevrilmeyeceği CDL-A05'in kararıdır.
belirsiz.semaKural.Proje: Tanı kodları (`katı-rejim-altkatman-eksik` · `auth-omurgası-ihlali` · `üretimsiz-meyve` · `beceri-drift`) çevrilmedi, çünkü bunlar kimliktir ve sınama süiti onlara dizge olarak bağlıdır; CDL-A03 de tanı KODLARININ sabit kalacağını söyler. Kodların İngilizce eşlerinin doğup doğmayacağı ayrı bir Founder kararıdır.
belirsiz.parametre.teknolojiBağımsız: technologyAgnostic seçildi; alan bir BOOLEAN değil bir GEREKÇE metni taşır, bu yüzden technologyAgnosticReason daha kesin olurdu. Ayrıca deponun kendi deyimi `stack-agnostik`tir (Yetenek tipinin ne alanı böyle der) ve stackAgnostic de savunulabilir.
